hook.en: Why does chicken last days in the fridge but spoils in hours on the kitchen table? Why does chopped charcoal light faster than big lumps at a satay stall? Chemists control how FAST reactions happen.
hook.bm: Mengapa ayam tahan beberapa hari dalam peti sejuk tetapi rosak dalam beberapa jam di atas meja? Mengapa arang yang dipotong kecil lebih cepat menyala di gerai satay? Ahli kimia mengawal KELAJUAN tindak balas.

bigIdeas.en: Rate of reaction = change in amount of reactant or product ÷ time.
bigIdeas.bm: Kadar tindak balas = perubahan kuantiti bahan atau hasil ÷ masa.

bigIdeas.en: Rate is fastest at the start and decreases as reactants are used up.
bigIdeas.bm: Kadar paling tinggi pada awal dan berkurang apabila bahan tindak balas digunakan.

bigIdeas.en: Size of particles, concentration, temperature, catalyst and pressure affect rate.
bigIdeas.bm: Saiz zarah, kepekatan, suhu, mangkin dan tekanan mempengaruhi kadar.

bigIdeas.en: Collision theory: particles must collide with enough energy (≥ activation energy) and the right orientation.
bigIdeas.bm: Teori perlanggaran: zarah mesti berlanggar dengan tenaga cukup (≥ tenaga pengaktifan) dan orientasi betul.

detail.bm: lebih banyak zarah per isi padu

definition.en: Change in quantity of reactant or product per unit time.
definition.bm: Perubahan kuantiti bahan atau hasil tindak balas per unit masa.

term.bm: Kadar tindak balas pada masa tertentu

definition.en: Rate at a particular moment = gradient of the tangent on the graph.
definition.bm: Kadar pada satu saat = kecerunan tangen pada graf.

definition.en: Minimum energy colliding particles need to react.
definition.bm: Tenaga minimum yang diperlukan zarah berlanggar untuk bertindak balas.

definition.en: A collision that leads to a reaction.
Speeds up a reaction by providing a path with lower activation energy; unchanged at the end.
definition.bm: Mempercepat tindak balas dengan menyediakan laluan bertenaga pengaktifan lebih rendah; tidak berubah di akhir.

question.en: Marble chips react with acid. 60 cm³ of CO₂ is collected in the first 2 minutes. Find the average rate in cm³ s⁻¹.
question.bm: Ketulan marmar bertindak balas dengan asid. 60 cm³ CO₂ dikumpul dalam 2 minit pertama. Cari kadar purata dalam cm³ s⁻¹.

prompt.en: 60 cm³ of gas is collected in 120 s. Find the average rate of reaction in cm³ s⁻¹.
prompt.bm: 60 cm³ gas dikumpul dalam 120 s. Cari kadar tindak balas purata dalam cm³ s⁻¹.

prompt.en: The gradient of a volume-of-gas against time graph decreases over time because…
prompt.bm: Kecerunan graf isi padu gas melawan masa berkurang dengan masa kerana…

options.en: more gas is produced each second
options.bm: lebih banyak gas dihasilkan setiap saat

explanation.en: As reactants are used up, there are fewer collisions per second, so the rate drops until it stops.
explanation.bm: Apabila bahan tindak balas digunakan, perlanggaran per saat berkurang, jadi kadar menurun hingga berhenti.

prompt.en: How is the rate at exactly 30 s found from a graph?
prompt.bm: Bagaimana kadar tepat pada 30 s ditentukan daripada graf?

options.en: Draw a tangent at 30 s and find its gradient
options.bm: Lukis tangen pada 30 s dan cari kecerunannya

options.en: Find the area under the graph

explanation.en: The instantaneous rate is the gradient of the tangent at that time.
explanation.bm: Kadar pada masa tertentu ialah kecerunan tangen pada masa itu.

prompt.en: Select ALL changes that INCREASE the rate of zinc reacting with hydrochloric acid.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA perubahan yang MENINGKATKAN kadar tindak balas zink dengan asid hidroklorik.

options.en: Use zinc powder instead of granules
options.bm: Guna serbuk zink dan bukan ketulan

options.en: Add copper(II) sulfate solution as a catalyst
options.bm: Tambah larutan kuprum(II) sulfat sebagai mangkin

explanation.en: Surface area, concentration, temperature and catalyst all increase the frequency of effective collisions.
explanation.bm: Luas permukaan, kepekatan, suhu dan mangkin semuanya meningkatkan frekuensi perlanggaran berkesan.

prompt.en: Experiment I uses 2 g of marble chips with excess acid; experiment II uses 2 g of marble powder with the same acid. How do the final volumes of CO₂ compare?
prompt.bm: Eksperimen I guna 2 g ketulan marmar dengan asid berlebihan; eksperimen II guna 2 g serbuk marmar dengan asid yang sama. Bandingkan isi padu akhir CO₂.

options.en: Same final volume, but II reaches it faster
options.bm: Isi padu akhir sama, tetapi II mencapainya lebih cepat
II memberi dua kali isi padu

explanation.en: Same mass of limiting reactant → same amount of product. Smaller size only changes the speed.
explanation.bm: Jisim bahan penghad sama → kuantiti hasil sama. Saiz lebih kecil hanya mengubah kelajuan.

prompt.en: Match each daily practice to the factor it uses.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap amalan harian dengan faktor yang digunakan.

left.en: Cutting meat into small pieces to cook

explanation.en: A pressure cooker raises the boiling point of water, so food cooks at a higher temperature.
explanation.bm: Periuk tekanan menaikkan takat didih air, jadi makanan dimasak pada suhu lebih tinggi.

prompt.en: In the Haber process (making ammonia), which catalyst is used?
prompt.bm: Dalam proses Haber (menghasilkan ammonia), mangkin manakah digunakan?

explanation.en: Haber: iron catalyst, ~450 °C, 200 atm. Contact process uses V₂O₅.
explanation.bm: Haber: mangkin besi, ~450 °C, 200 atm. Proses Sentuh guna V₂O₅.

prompt.en: According to collision theory, why does raising temperature increase rate?
prompt.bm: Menurut teori perlanggaran, mengapa menaikkan suhu meningkatkan kadar?

options.en: Particles move faster, collide more often, and more collisions have energy ≥ activation energy
options.bm: Zarah bergerak lebih laju, berlanggar lebih kerap, dan lebih banyak perlanggaran bertenaga ≥ tenaga pengaktifan

explanation.en: Higher frequency of EFFECTIVE collisions. Only a catalyst lowers activation energy.
explanation.bm: Frekuensi perlanggaran BERKESAN lebih tinggi. Hanya mangkin merendahkan tenaga pengaktifan.

prompt.en: The minimum energy colliding particles need in order to react is called the ______ energy.
prompt.bm: Tenaga minimum yang diperlukan oleh zarah yang berlanggar untuk bertindak balas dipanggil tenaga ______.

explanation.en: A catalyst gives an alternative path with lower activation energy.
explanation.bm: Mangkin memberi laluan alternatif dengan tenaga pengaktifan lebih rendah.

prompt.en: Sodium thiosulfate reacts with acid to form yellow sulfur. A cross under the flask disappears faster at 50 °C than at 30 °C. What is the responding variable?
prompt.bm: Natrium tiosulfat bertindak balas dengan asid membentuk sulfur kuning. Pangkah di bawah kelalang hilang lebih cepat pada 50 °C berbanding 30 °C. Apakah pemboleh ubah bergerak balas?

options.en: Time for the cross to disappear

explanation.en: Temperature is manipulated; time (and so 1/time as a measure of rate) is the responding variable.
explanation.bm: Suhu dimanipulasikan; masa (dan 1/masa sebagai ukuran kadar) ialah pemboleh ubah bergerak balas.
